summary: First full test round for DompetBerdua (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass covering auth (email/phone/login/wrong-pass/protected-route), pairing (invite+join+invalid-code+already-paired), categories (defaults+duplicates), transactions (create/list/filters/owner-scope/soft-delete/partner-visibility), summary (period+owner+trend), budgets (upsert+80%+100% thresholds for both members), notifications (transaction+read-all), upload (201). Frontend: login works, Beranda renders (balance, period chips, Gabungan/Kamu/Pasangan segmented, pie chart, 6-month trend, recent tx), Tambah renders and Rp thousands formatting works (50000 -> 50.000), Simpan Transaksi shows 'Transaksi tersimpan' toast and resets amount, Riwayat lists tx grouped by day with search + owner/month filter chips, Anggaran shows month chips + 6m line + 80% warning banner + progress row with 'Hampir Habis'/'Terlampaui' status, Profil shows partner 'Terhubung' badge + unread badge, dark-mode toggle switches all screens to dark and PERSISTS after reload, Notifications screen lists budget+transaction+pairing entries. Two real issues found: (1) /api/files/{path} returns 502 because requests.get is called with positional headers, so receipt image download is broken end-to-end even though upload succeeds; (2) tab bar buttons in (tabs)/_layout.tsx have no testID attributes making UI test navigation less robust (routes-based navigation still works). All previously-reported cosmetic warnings (gifted-charts responder props, expo-notifications web warning, passlib bcrypt warning, push relay 401) confirmed as non-blocking.

critical.issue: Returns 502 for every file. In server.py line 462-464 requests.get is called via run_in_threadpool with positional args (url, None, {'X-Storage-Key': key}, None, 60); the headers dict is passed as the `params` argument. Use keyword args: run_in_threadpool(lambda: requests.get(url, headers={'X-Storage-Key': key}, timeout=60)) or pass headers via kwargs. Receipt image preview will be broken in the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Bottom tab items have no testID (only screen name). Add testID via tabBarButton wrapper (e.g. tab-beranda / tab-tambah / tab-riwayat / tab-anggaran / tab-profil) so playwright can tap tabs directly instead of relying on router.push URLs.

Gifted-charts LineChart passes onPressOut/onStartShouldSetResponder to <circle>; on web this triggers a red Console Error overlay in Expo dev mode that partially overlays the UI on first render. Consider disabling data-point press handlers on web (Platform.OS === 'web') or wrapping in <View pointerEvents='none'>. Same happens on Anggaran trend chart.

integration_issues.issue: Upload works but GET /api/files/{path} returns 502, so any <Image source={{uri: `${BASE}/api/files/${path}?token=...`}} /> will fail to render receipts once uploaded.

react_native_issues.issue: Push token listener 'not fully supported on web' — expected per problem statement, no fix needed.

action_items: Fix GET /api/files/{path} in server.py: call requests.get with keyword args (headers=, timeout=) via run_in_threadpool(functools.partial(...)) or a lambda. Verify by GETting a freshly uploaded path and expecting 200 image/png.
Add testID to bottom tab buttons in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (Tabs.Screen options.tabBarButton wrapper with testID={`tab-${tab.name}`}) so E2E tab taps are reliable.
Optional: on Platform.OS === 'web', skip data-point press handlers on gifted-charts LineChart (Beranda + Anggaran) to remove the dev LogBox overlay for onPressOut/responder unknown handlers.

rca_of_issue: GET /api/files/{path} 502 RCA: run_in_threadpool(requests.get, url, None, {'X-Storage-Key': key}, None, 60) forwards positional args to requests.get whose signature is (url, params=None, **kwargs). The headers dict ends up as `params`, and the remaining Nones/60 as extra positional args, raising TypeError inside the thread; the outer try/except converts it into HTTPException(502, 'Gagal memuat file'). Reproduction: POST /api/upload (201) → GET returned path → 502. Fix: `resp = await run_in_threadpool(lambda: requests.get(f"{STORAGE_URL}/objects/{path}", headers={'X-Storage-Key': key}, timeout=60))`.
